# Rumor Tables — Severed Lands

Roll 1d20 per tavern visit, market stop, or whenever the party asks around. Rumor accuracy is marked: (T)rue, (P)artially true, (F)alse but believed, (L)ead to follow.

---

## Waystation — The Main Hall

| Roll | Rumor |
|------|-------|
| 1 | "The Door flickered again last night. Nine seconds this time. Linden hasn't slept since." (T) |
| 2 | "Someone's been stealing from the armory. The Quartermaster's furious. They think it's an inside job." (T) |
| 3 | "V is coming back. Next week. They found a Door out in the deep Cairnfields. Intact." (P — V IS returning, the Door lead is unconfirmed) |
| 4 | "There's a Radical cell in Waystation. Someone in this room, maybe. V's going to purge them when they get back." (P — cell exists, purge is speculation) |
| 5 | "Old Crane signaled last night. Three flashes. That's the emergency code. No one's gone to check yet." (T) |
| 6 | "The Quartermaster can identify any weapon by weight alone. I saw them do it blindfolded." (T) |
| 7 | "Marla's spice blend is almost gone. Once it runs out, we're eating plain rations until the next caravan." (T) |
| 8 | "The Door isn't dormant. It's waiting. It knows something we don't." (F — but commonly believed) |
| 9 | "Pike almost got himself killed last patrol. Charged a riftwolf alone. Stern had to save him." (T) |
| 10 | "There's a Door fragment in the Cairnfields that matches one in V's study. Put together, they form a map." (P — fragment exists, map theory is Linden's speculation) |
| 11 | "Tallow's been asking for an escort into the Deep Rift. No one's volunteered. No one's stupid enough." (T) |
| 12 | "The Lace Brothers have a Warden artifact — a complete one. They're auctioning it. The Returners can't afford to bid." (T) |
| 13 | "Henna delivered a baby last week. Mother and child are fine. The baby's eyes opened violet." (T — the violet eyes are true, significance unknown) |
| 14 | "The Radials tried to recruit me. Offered me gold and a place in the new order when the Door opens." (P — recruitment is happening, "new order" is speculation) |
| 15 | "Old Finch says he remembers when the Hollows was still a city. He says the phasing didn't start until after the Wardens disappeared." (P — Finch DOES say this, truth uncertain) |
| 16 | "Echo the bard passed through last month. Sang a song that made half the hall cry. No one knows what language it was." (T) |
| 17 | "V isn't trying to open the Door. They're trying to keep something from coming through." (F — but persistent rumor, V has never addressed it) |
| 18 | "The Deep Rift in the Cairnfields is getting bigger. A prospector said it's grown ten feet since last season." (T) |
| 19 | "Sister Candle found her pack. She's asking for help. She's not asking for mercy." (T) |
| 20 | "V's been gone too long. Something's wrong. The senior Returners are talking about sending a search party." (L — if followed, leads to a mission to find V) |

| 19 | "The council is going to crack down on the Warrens. Voss has been pushing for it. Harlan's trying to delay." (P — Voss IS pushing, crackdown timing uncertain) |

| Roll | Rumor |
|------|-------|
| 1 | "Sister Iron says the Doors will speak again within the year. The Athenaeum is scrambling to position someone to hear it." (T) |
| 2 | "Father Glass has been meeting with Athenaeum scholars in secret. Comparing Church doctrine with Warden inscriptions. He found something." (T) |
| 3 | "The Revealers are planning to occupy a Door site. Sister Iron hasn't blessed it. They're going to do it anyway." (T) |
| 4 | "Doctor Cipher's Pool Stabilizer is almost ready. She's recruiting for a test. The pay is generous. The risk is absolute." (T) |
| 5 | "Guildmaster Vance and Lady Trask have been meeting. They're planning a direct trade route that bypasses Thornwall." (T) |
| 6 | "The Inkwell's maps show routes through the Hollows that don't exist yet. Routes that won't exist until the next phasing event." (T) |

| 8 | "Councillor Merrow is pushing for a Riftborn Quarter in Thornwall. Voss is fighting it. The vote is in two weeks." (T) |
| 9 | "The Caravaneers' Guild is splitting. Reformer versus traditionalist. Orin Thatch is retiring. The election's going to be ugly." (T) |

| 11 | "The Mirror in the Crossroads told me I'd find what I was looking for within the week. Still waiting." (P — readings are often accurate but timing is vague) |

| 13 | "Fume's last experiment blew out the windows of his stall. He was back selling the next morning. The Crossroads regulars think he's immortal." (T) |
| 14 | "The Undercroft connects to the Hollows. Officially denied. Vale knows the route. They won't take it." (T) |
| 15 | "A Rememberer's body was found near a dead Anchor Door. Their ledger was open. Every name crossed out by someone else." (T) |

| 17 | "Old Crane once told me the Veil shows you things when you phase-step. He wouldn't say what he's seen. He said I wouldn't want to know." (T) |
| 18 | "There's a Warden structure in the deep Cairnfields. Intact. Humming. The Raiders found it. They don't know what to do with it." (T) |

---

## Using These Tables

- **Plant rumors early.** A rumor heard in Session 2 pays off in Session 6. Track which rumors the party has heard.
- **Mix truth levels.** Some rumors should be dead on, some should be distorted, some should be completely wrong — but passionately believed by the NPC.
- **Rumors react to the party.** If the party is aligned with the Returners, they hear Thornwall rumors that paint the council as antagonistic. If they're neutral, they hear a more balanced mix.
- **Rumors expire.** A rumor about "the vote is in two weeks" should resolve — the vote passes, the vote fails, the vote is delayed. The world moves on.
